en-US.description: A web/desktop client for the Pi native coding agent.
en-US.longDescription:
PiUI is a web and desktop client for the Pi native coding agent: PiUI provides the interface, session browsing, and extension UI, while agent execution is powered by the Pi SDK.
Conversations require configured Pi provider credentials. PiUI can also run as a backend server only, accessed through a browser frontend (127.0.0.1:8787 by default).
en-US.releaseNotes:
- fix(diff): unstick diff viewer stuck rendering only overscan rows (ea5a9dff)
- feat(notifications): open extensions panel when clicking extension notifications (977f28da)

PiUI 是 Pi 原生 coding agent 的 Web/桌面客户端：界面、session 浏览和扩展 UI 由 PiUI 提供，agent 执行由 Pi SDK 提供。
对话需要配置 Pi 的 provider 凭据；PiUI 也可以只启动后端 server，通过浏览器前端访问（默认 127.0.0.1:8787）。
